title: Chryselephantine
html_source:
Made of or gilded with gold and ivory. From Greek χρυσός, chrysós, ‘gold’, and ελεφάντινος, elephántinos, ‘ivory’) is sculpture made with gold and ivory. Famously the enormous statue of Athena Parthenos in the Parthenon, now lost, was made in chryselephantine fashion by Phidias.

The flag of the Vatican is also gold and white:
